approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A whimsical cinematic stop-motion-style miniature diorama, warm sunrise light, tactile handmade textures. A tiny charming brass robot with round turquoise eyes stands beside a towering sunflower in a terracotta pot on a miniature rooftop above a sea of soft peach clouds. One continuous six-second shot: the robot carefully tilts a tiny blue watering can, pouring a visible sparkling stream of water onto the soil at the sunflower's base. The sunflower gently sways toward the little robot as if saying thank you, and the robot looks up with delighted glowing eyes, still holding the can. Slow subtle camera push-in, medium-wide framing keeping both the entire robot and the sunflower blossom visible, shallow depth of field, enchanting golden light, beautifully detailed water droplets. Consistent characters and objects, no cuts, no text, no logos.
